technical_review.assessment: The first sentence describes ordinary fitting. The second introduces excessive fitting as a condition, and the third states a possible consequence on unseen data. Together they describe an introductory noise-fitting mechanism without stating that normal learning always overfits or that unseen-data error must increase.
technical_review.scope_limit: These sentences explain one common overfitting mechanism, not an exhaustive account of all causes.

visual_checks.numbered_text: The three items are distinct and sequential. In the directly inspected representative views each sentence occupies three lines; the Navy number aligns with its first text line.
visual_checks.layout: The list remains within the 185px-wide borderless aside. Item spacing, text wrapping and the bottom of item 3 are clear; there is no overlap with the main loss graph or card boundary.
visual_checks.simplification: Readers no longer need to interpret the miniature line comparison or its separate color roles to follow the cause explanation.
visual_checks.preserved_page: Blue concept labels, Navy titles, definitions, figure headings, loss legend, axes, selected minimum, best.pt, fruit/model diagram, takeaway and footer remain readable.
visual_checks.variants: The eight-view contact shows consistent list layout in both modes and all four PC sizes. The central-minimum view remains collision-free with the list present.

preservation.classification: C: topic-specific wording and explanatory structure refined after user comprehension feedback. Existing common spacing, typography and colors are reused; no new common Markdown omission is established.

history_and_limits: The former miniature graphs passed drawing arithmetic and browser geometry checks. Those results did not prove beginner comprehension, and user feedback showed that the former explanation did not meet the expected simplicity. Historical reports remain preserved.
This review verifies the revised wording, technical conditionality, actual visual layout and regression evidence. It is not a reader study or proof that every beginner understands the material.
